scenarios.title: Give it a goal. Follow the result.
scenarios.prompt: Review these project notes, check the open questions and prepare a short action list.
scenarios.output: Share files in the conversation. Bot can delegate longer work, show task progress and bring the findings back. Review any action that needs your approval.

scenarios.title: Show the part you mean.
scenarios.prompt: Help me understand this part of the screen.
scenarios.output: Use F1 to select a region, mark it up or redact it, then copy, save or send it to Bot. Ask Bot needs a model that supports images. F3 pins a clipboard image for reference.

scenarios.title: Keep the useful context close.
scenarios.input: Leave a note for next time:
scenarios.prompt: Remember this project’s writing preferences, and remind me tomorrow to review the draft.
scenarios.output: Keep editable Markdown notes in Notebook and ask for reminders. Reminders need Bot to stay running; hiding the character keeps it available, while quitting pauses scheduling.

en.setupTitle: From download to your first conversation.
en.setupIntro: Choose your connection, then make it yours.
setup: Use the macOS DMG on Apple Silicon, or the Windows x64 installer. Open the verified app and follow the first-run guide.
Caelis is included in the desktop packages. Choose a model service and complete its login. Or use your own local Codex installation and account.
Choose a model, optional screenshot tools, and your assistant’s name. Share a question or a file; you can change these choices later in Settings.
en.connectionsTitle: Your models. Your way of working.
en.connectionsIntro: Set up what you need, when you need it.
connections: Choose the model you talk to and a separate default for background work in Connections & Models. Available models and image support depend on your connection.
Add supported plugins from Settings. Each service has its own setup, account and permissions. Desktop actions may use the foreground and need system access.
Connect Telegram to the same Bot conversation. On macOS, configure an SSH machine for work you explicitly send there; accounts and files are not automatically copied.
faqs: Which computers can run it?

macOS packages are for Apple Silicon. Windows packages target Windows 10 22H2 x64 or later and need Microsoft Edge WebView2; native development testing used Windows 11. Intel Mac, Windows ARM64 and Linux desktop packages are not offered.
Does the download include a model or a subscription?

It includes Caelis, the software that connects to model services. It does not include a model-service account, credits or a subscription. Codex uses your own local installation and login. Provider terms and charges still apply.
Is my conversation entirely offline?

Notes and application data are kept on your computer. Prompts and attachments may be sent to the model provider or connected service you choose. Review a screenshot before sharing it; manual capture sends the selection you confirm.
Can I hide the character or close chat?
Yes. Bot stays in the menu bar on macOS or the system tray on Windows. Hiding the character or closing chat does not quit it. Use Quit to end the app.
How do updates work?

Check Settings → Updates. Restart and installation require your confirmation. Keep application data when replacing the app. Windows Stable and Preview have separate installations and data; installing Stable does not migrate Preview data.
en.windowsNotice: Windows downloads are not Authenticode signed. SmartScreen or your organization’s policy may warn or block installation; see the installation guide.

scenarios.title: 交代目标，跟进结果
scenarios.input: 从一个明确的请求开始：
scenarios.prompt: 整理这些项目笔记，核对待确认的问题，再列一份简短的行动清单。
scenarios.output: 在对话中分享文件。较长的工作可以交给后台任务，进展和结果回到原来的对话；遇到需要你决定的操作，再由你确认。

scenarios.title: 把想问的地方，指给它看
scenarios.prompt: 帮我解释屏幕上这一部分。
scenarios.output: 按 F1 选择区域，标注或脱敏后复制、保存或发送给 Bot。“问 Bot”需要支持图片的模型；按 F3 可将剪贴板图片贴在桌面上，方便参照。

scenarios.title: 让有用的上下文留在身边
scenarios.input: 为下一次留下一条笔记：
scenarios.prompt: 记下这个项目的写作偏好，明天提醒我检查初稿。
scenarios.output: Notebook 保存可编辑的 Markdown 笔记，也可以在对话中安排提醒。提醒需要 Bot 保持运行；隐藏角色不影响调度，退出应用后会暂停。

zh-cn.setupIntro: 选好连接，认识你的新伙伴。
setup: Apple Silicon Mac 使用 DMG，Windows x64 使用安装程序。校验下载后打开应用，跟随首次引导开始。
桌面安装包已内置 Caelis，选择模型服务并完成登录即可。也可以使用你自己安装并登录的 Codex。
确认模型，选择截图等附加功能，再为助手起个名字。问一个问题，或分享一个文件；这些选择之后都可以在设置中调整。
zh-cn.connectionsTitle: 你的模型，你的工作方式。
connections: 在“连接与模型”中选择 Bot 的对话模型，也可以单独设置后台工作的默认模型。可选模型与图片能力取决于已连接的服务。
从设置添加支持的插件，按各服务要求完成账号和权限配置。电脑操作可能需要切换到前台，并取得系统权限。
将 Telegram 连接到同一个 Bot 对话。在 macOS 中还可配置 SSH 远程机器，明确指定工作交给哪台机器；账号和文件不会自动复制。
faqs: 支持哪些电脑？
macOS 安装包适用于 Apple Silicon。Windows 安装包要求 Windows 10 22H2 x64 或更新版本及 Microsoft Edge WebView2，原生开发测试使用 Windows 11。目前没有 Intel Mac、Windows ARM64 或 Linux 桌面安装包。
下载后就有模型和订阅吗？
安装包内置的是连接模型服务的软件 Caelis，不包含模型服务账号、额度或订阅。Codex 使用你自己的本机安装和登录；各服务的使用条款与费用仍然适用。
对话完全离线吗？
笔记和应用数据保存在你的电脑上；请求和附件可能发送给你选择的模型服务或已连接的应用。分享截图前可以先检查，手动截图只发送你确认的选区。
可以隐藏角色或关掉聊天吗？
可以。Bot 仍驻留在 macOS 菜单栏或 Windows 系统托盘中。隐藏角色、关闭聊天不会退出应用；选择“退出”才会结束运行。
怎样更新？
在“设置 → 更新”中检查，重启安装前由你确认。手动替换应用时请保留应用数据。Windows 正式版与预览版的安装和数据相互独立，安装正式版不会迁移预览版数据。
zh-cn.windowsNotice: Windows 下载尚未进行 Authenticode 签名，SmartScreen 或组织策略可能提示或阻止安装，详情见安装指南。
